meta.method: Resnik best-match-average over direct annotations; IC over all phenotype.hpoa diseases (aspect P, NOT rows dropped, is_a propagation); percentile = share of all compared non-slice diseases scoring lower; shared terms = most informative common ancestors of the best matches (distinctive = IC >= 4.0).
meta.excluded_rule: slice profile entities, and any disease whose genes_to_disease.txt genes include a slice gene (e.g. multi-gene CMS or GEFS+ groupings); diseases with fewer than 5 direct phenotype terms (Resnik BMA over-rewards tiny profiles); QTL and susceptibility loci
